title: Extracellular DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Charline Giguet-Covex
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdwsi7ee

steps.title: Prepare phosphate buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the phosphate buffer the same day as the extraction. In DNA‑free water add 1970 mg NaH₂PO₄ and 14700 mg Na₂HPO₄ per litre and mix until completely dissolved (no visible powder). If any undissolved material remains, place the solution in a UV box for 15 min.

steps.title: Add phosphate buffer to samples
steps.instruction: To each 50 mL Falcon tube add a volume of phosphate buffer equal to 2–3 × the dry weight of the sediment (e.g., 15 mL for 5 g dry sediment). Mix on an orbital shaker for 15 min. During shaking label the downstream collection tubes, Amicon filters and green columns, and pre‑add 200 µL of SB buffer to the tubes that will receive the extract.

steps.title: Centrifuge to separate sediment
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 50 mL Falcon tubes at 4400 rpm (temperature not specified) for 10 min to pellet the sediment.

steps.title: Concentrate supernatant and heat SE
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to Amicon filters and centrifuge in 10‑min intervals at the same speed until the volume is reduced to approximately 400 µL (final volume may range 450–700 µL). Record the initial and final volumes on aluminium foil. Heat the required volume of SE (the elution buffer) to 80 °C in 1.5 mL or 2 mL tubes.

steps.title: Prepare SW2 buffer (first use)
steps.instruction: For the first use of the SW2 buffer (250‑prep kit), add 400 mL ethanol to 100 mL SW2 concentrate and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Bind DNA to silica column
steps.instruction: Mix 400 µL of the concentrated extract with 200 µL SB buffer, resuspend, and transfer the 600 µL mixture onto a green column from the NucleoSpin® Soil kit (Macherey‑Nagel). Centrifuge at 11 000 rpm (temperature not specified) for 1 min and discard the flow‑through. Prepare a control by mixing 400 µL phosphate buffer with 200 µL SB buffer and processing it identically.

steps.title: Wash silica membrane
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes on the column:

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL SB buffer, centrifuge 11 000 rpm for 30 s, discard flow‑through.
Add 550 µL SW1 buffer, centrifuge 11 000 rpm for 30 s, discard flow‑through.
Add 700 µL SW2 buffer (prepared with ethanol), centrifuge 11 000 rpm for 30 s, discard flow‑through.
Add another 700 µL SW2 buffer, centrifuge 11 000 rpm for 30 s, discard flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry silica membrane
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 11 000 rpm for 2 min to remove residual wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute DNA and store
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new 1.5 mL collection tube. Add 50 µL SE, incubate at room temperature for 1 min with the lid open, then 4 min with the lid closed. Centrifuge 11 000 rpm for 30 s. Repeat with an additional 50 µL SE to obtain a total eluate of 100 µL. Store eluate at –20 °C. DNA is now ready for quantification (e.g., Qubit or Quantifluor® ONE) and downstream PCR.
